name: PlayerLookingThroughLoadout
summary: The `lookingThroughLoadout` member body of the Player replicated state: one strict zero-or-one byte. The member's reader 0x1417b4c20 accepts only a byte below 2, so the card declares bool_byte and the codec refuses any other value.
purpose: Name the member layout the Player presence mask selects (group 1 member 3 of codec.player-component-replicated-state).

fields.name: value
fields.note: One raw byte read by 0x1417b4c20 through FUN_1408787b0; the reader stores it only when it is below 2. The measured 0x9e body carries 00. The reflection string at 0x14855a500 says lookingThroughLoadout; what the flag enables is not proven, so the field stays layout-only.

evidence.ref: research/fixtures/wire/state-fragment-3935.hex: the 3-byte payload 02 08 00 parses as group 1, member 3, then this one byte, and re-encodes byte-exactly.
